meta.title: Christen Football Coaching — Duval County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Jacksonville, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach Christen
about.bio: Seeing the advancement of youth flag football and the sport in general has always been a passion of mine! Since I entered the sport in 2012, I’ve seen it grow tremendously on an international stage. It also has provided me with a community of colleagues, friends and even family. So, I have a personal connection with the sport as well. I would love to see the sport grow within the high school and college ranks even more than it has already began to. Therefore, I would like to do my part by passing on the knowledge that I’ve been able to gather over these years to the younger generation so that they may have more opportunities down the line as a student-athlete!

hero.headline: Duval County's Premier Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.

testimonials.quote: Coach Christen changed the way I see the game. I went from second-string to starter in one season.
testimonials.name: Marcus T.

testimonials.quote: My son has trained with Coach Christen for two years. The improvement is night and day.
testimonials.name: Patricia L.
